item.text: The red sunflower is a perennial native from Mexico to Central America, though it grows as an annual in cooler climates. It has orange or red flowers, grey-topped leaves with hairy undersides, and brittle stems; its flowers provide nectar for migrating monarch butterflies, hummingbirds and other pollinators.
